name: Truth Hurts
notes: Aftermath's R&B signing on DJ Quik and Dr. Dre's Bollywood-sample hybrid; the research gives the era as 2002 alone and it is not widened here. Tempo is "76–99 straight (backbeat 2&4)" with the sourced record at 99 and its slower sibling at 76. Three drum deltas from "Aftermath-era kit with a hard 2&4 snare, kick on 1 and the 8th before 3, tabla-adjacent percussion from the sample, and a dry, close mix": a velocity-tier spread with the accent at 114–127 against a 86–100 main (that is what "hard" and "dry" mean when the only control is dynamics), a snare pinned within 2 ms of the grid, and a four-lane bongo/conga/timbale/perc bed at five to six hits a bar and −5 dB, which is the tabla-adjacent layer. Harmony is stated as a consequence of the sample: "the whole harmonic identity is the sampled vocal/instrumental line… looped against a static bass — one chord, ornamented melodically". So a single-chord family carries a weight of 8 and `chordDurationBeats` runs 16–32. "Modal minor inherited from the Hindi source — the sample's raga colour, not a Western functional progression" is why `scales` leads with phrygian and `halfStepDissonance` is 0.3, the highest in this section, with `chordToneBias` dropped to 0.6: the line ornaments a mode rather than spelling a chord. "The lead sings inside the sample's mode with long held notes" is the legato articulation and the 2–6 density. ⚠ Every velocity, density and register number is INFERRED; the research gives sample lineage, producers and tempo, not a kit. ⚠ `session.keys` is INFERRED: the entry's Keys line gives "modal minor inherited from the Hindi source — the sample's raga colour, not a Western functional progression" and enumerates no tonic, so the values here and their weights are this author's reading of that line. ⚠ **`chords.impliedByRiff` declared (2026-08-17, harmony variety floor).** The entry says "the whole harmonic identity is the sampled vocal/instrumental line from Lata Mangeshkar's 'Thoda Resham Lagta Hai' (1981) looped against a static bass - **one chord, ornamented melodically**", and "the lead sings inside the sample's mode". A looped melodic line stating the harmony over one chord is precisely what this flag describes, so the chord lane is narrow by research; the alternative would have been a progression the entry explicitly denies ("the sample's raga colour, not a Western functional progression"). ⚠ Consequence: `generators::melody` raises `chordToneBias` from 0.6 to the 0.85 floor; `halfStepDissonance: 0.3` is a separate knob and still carries the raga colour. ⚠ **The countermelody reached 969/1000 distinct answers against a floor of 980 (2026-08-17, counter variety floor), and every other lever this gate has was already clean here** — no empty-bar bias, no one-bar phrase length, and no lead allowed to thin below two notes a bar. What was left was the style pool: `generators::counter` can play five answer shapes and this block asked for 2. `octave_echo` is added at weight 2 because the entry already names it — "the whole harmonic identity is the sampled vocal/instrumental line from Lata Mangeshkar’s "Thoda Resham Lagta Hai" (1981) looped against a static bass — one chord, ornamented melodically — and a hook that doubles the sample melody" — and a hook that doubles the sample melody is a transposed copy of the lead, which is `octave_echo`. ⚠ The weight is INFERRED; the layer it weights is not.
